appDesc.message: Make Google Gemini wider, denser, and easier to read with responsive width, reading density controls, and code wrapping.

headerSubtitle.message: Make the conversation interface wider and more comfortable

infoText1.message: Drag the slider or click preset buttons to adjust width

infoText2.message: Settings are automatically saved and applied to all Gemini tabs

localeCode.description: HTML language tag for this translation.

helpOpenPopup.message: Open Gemini, then click the Wider Gemini toolbar icon to adjust your settings.

helpWidthBody.message: Choose px for a fixed width or % to follow the window size. Move the slider or choose a preset; each unit has its own presets.

helpCodeBody.message: Turn on Code Auto Wrap to read long lines without as much horizontal scrolling. Turn it off to preserve unbroken code lines.

helpReadingBody.message: Adjust font size from 75% to 200% without zooming the whole page. At Auto density 0, native paragraph gaps and line-height proportions are preserved. Higher density gradually reduces native spacing. Advanced spacing sets exact manual values; Reset spacing returns to Auto at the current density.

helpLiveSettings.message: Changes apply to open Gemini tabs and are saved automatically. Sync across devices depends on your browser's sync settings.

helpTroubleshootPage.message: Check that you are on gemini.google.com and Wider Gemini is enabled. It also works with this website installed as a Chrome app (PWA). Google's native desktop apps are not supported.

helpTroubleshootRefresh.message: If a setting does not appear after installing or updating the extension, reload the Gemini page once and try again.

helpTroubleshootReport.message: If the problem continues, note the steps to reproduce it and your window size. A screenshot with private content removed can help; mention any other extensions that change Gemini's layout.

helpDiagnosticsPrivacy.message: Generate a report to preview before sharing it in an issue. It includes only the extension version, browser major version, platform, and layout settings. It contains no chats, page URLs, titles, or custom preset names. Nothing is sent automatically.

helpSupportProject.message: If Wider Gemini helps you, you can star the project or leave an honest review.

helpReportReady.message: Report ready. Review it, then copy it if you want to share it.

helpReportError.message: Could not read settings. Reopen help from the extension and try again.

helpReportCopied.message: Copied. You can paste the report into your issue.

helpReportCopyFallback.message: Copy was unavailable. The report is selected; copy it manually.

taskHint.message: Uses your width limits. Restore returns the four settings above to their values before the last Apply.

taskPreview.message: Width {width} · Font {font}% · Native spacing · Code wrap {wrap}

taskApplied.message: Applied. Previous settings are saved on this device.

taskSaveError.message: Could not save or load settings. Reopen the popup and try again.

helpTaskBody.message: Choose Long reading, Tables, Code, or Large text, review the settings, then click Apply. These change width, font size, spacing, and code wrapping. Your width limits still apply. Restore previous settings undoes the most recent task preset on this device, even after closing the popup; it replaces any later changes to those settings.

autoSpacingHint.message: Auto follows each message's native spacing. Moving either slider applies both values below manually.
